A 90Wh battery delivers up to 32.5 hours of video playback.⁴ With Thunderbolt 4⁵, HDMI, Dolby Atmos⁶, advanced cooling, and Copilot+ PC capabilities, gram Pro Max delivers premium power without the weight. A high-capacity 90Wh battery with AI-driven power optimization provides up to 32.5 hours of video playback.
